title.narrative: Advancing Ethical AI Governance and Inclusive Digital Transformation in Pacific SIDS

description.narrative: This work plan aims to strengthen the capacities of Pacific Member States and stakeholders to develop and implement ethical AI governance frameworks aligned with UNESCO’s Recommendation on the Ethics of AI, ensuring the integration of human rights, gender equality, and sustainability principles. As Pacific SIDS advance digital transformation, artificial intelligence presents opportunities to improve public services, decision-making, and economic innovation. However, limited institutional capacity, regulatory gaps, and risks related to bias, privacy, and inequality require context-specific and rights-based governance approaches. Building on UNESCO’s normative framework and intersectoral collaboration between Social and Human Sciences (SHS) and Communication and Information (CI), this initiative will support governments in translating AI ethics principles into practical policies, institutional mechanisms, and regulatory frameworks. It will promote inclusive governance by engaging diverse stakeholders, including women, youth, and under-represented groups, in shaping AI development and use. The rationale is to address gaps in AI governance readiness, limited technical and policy capacities, and the need to build trust in digital systems. Without ethical safeguards, AI risks exacerbating inequalities and undermining social cohesion. By strengthening policy frameworks, promoting multistakeholder dialogue, and building institutional capacities, UNESCO will support Pacific Member States in harnessing AI for sustainable and inclusive development.
